messages:
Priya: quick check-in on the 'transient-claim' approach i sketched yesterday. goal: reduce hot-path fanout for high-qps tenants while keeping auditable trails. want tradeoffs callouts before i open the RFC.
Tom: i like reduced fanout. two immediate Qs: 1) is claim authoritative or advisory? 2) how do we handle claim churn when clients retry heavily?
Priya: leaning advisory. final reconciliation component (reconciler) will settle claims into the canonical billing stream. claims act to route and short-circuit duplicate work.
Nadia: if advisory, audits need the raw claim stream + reconciler decisions to reconstruct who was billed. make sure both are immutable.
Devin: agree. also need to think about payload bloat. adding claim metadata inline to every event hurts throughput. sideload a compact claim stream instead?
Priya: exactly. two modes: INLINE (all claim fields in event) vs SIDELOAD (tiny claim messages keyed by req_fingerprint). SIDELOAD saves bytes but forces joins in consumers.
Leo: infra note: sideload joins are doable but increase tail latency. we should define a max join-lag SLO and gate join behavior on tenant profile. 200ms for PLG tenants, 2s for enterprise maybe.
Tom: operational complexity aside, SIDELOAD allows claim compaction. we can dedupe claim updates into checkpoint records every T minutes to shrink retention.
Nadia: checkpointing ok, but must record mapping from checkpoint -> stream offsets so reconciler can rebuild exactly. otherwise audit reconstruction is lossy.
Devin: reconciler algorithm idea: ingest raw events + claim stream, advance watermark; for each req, pick claim with highest score = weight(provenance) + recency_penalty + explicit_override_flag. settle and emit settled attribution event.
Priya: score components: provenance_hint (edge_cache, kv_cache, prefix_hit), claim_ttl_remaining, claim_source_reliability (frontend, sdk, sidecar). we'll include score reasons in settled event for traceability.
Tom: what about retries producing conflicting claims? need deterministic tie-breaker: prefer claim with later event_ts unless source_reliability differs. define precedence: sdk > edge > sidecar? discuss.
Nadia: let's keep precedence configurable but default to SDK > EDGE > FORWARDER. document expectations for SDK to be most reliable.
Priya: sketch of SIDELOAD claim message (compact):
```
{
  "req_fingerprint":"fp:v3:xyz",
  "claim_id":"claim-4160000000-01",
  "src":"sdk",
  "hints":["prefix_cached"],
  "expires_ts":4160000180
}
```
Devin: good. reconciler needs to snapshot claims for audit retention. storage strategy: keep raw claim stream + compacted checkpoints; checkpoints store last-claim-per-req for checkpoint window.
Leo: storage cost: raw stream retention for 7 days, checkpoints for 1 year? that's pricey. maybe raw stream short (3d) and checkpoints long (1y) with tombstones for deleted requests.
Priya: acceptable if reconciler can rebuild using checkpoints + last-3d raw tail. add a rebuild TTL guarantee in docs.
Tom: UX question: how do customers see differences between initial claim and settled billing? propose two fields in billing debug API: initial_claim_attribution and settled_attribution with reasons. invoices use settled_attribution.
Nadia: also add a reconciliation endpoint that returns full timeline of claim updates + decisions for a req_fingerprint for up to 90 days. helpful for SRE/customer support.
Devin: rollout plan: 1) emit SIDELOAD claims to a new topic behind feature flag 2) run reconciler in dry-run (emit settled events to staging only) 3) compare reconciler settled vs current ledger for canaries 4) flip to authoritative for selected tenants.
Leo: testing: add chaos tests for out-of-order claim delivery, duplicate claims, missing claim checkpoint recovery. also load-test checkpoint compaction.
Priya: security note: claims include no PII; keep fingerprint deterministic but salted per-workspace to prevent cross-tenant correlation.
Tom: docs needed: schema for INLINE and SIDELOAD, reconciler scoring math, checkpointing semantics, audit reconstruction recipe, rollout checklist.
Priya: i'll author RFC with those sections and include a reference implementation of reconciler scoring in pseudo-code. posting draft link shortly.
recon-bot: draft uploaded: https://go/repo/transient-claim-rfc (comments enabled) :rocket:
Devin: will review and add test matrix. thanks Priya. :thumbsup:
